work_completed: Step 0 first. (a) The write outside the worktree failed with "Read-only file system". (b) `git hash-object -w` and `git update-index --refresh` both worked. `GOV_ROLE` is `engineer` and `GOV_TICKET` is `DAEO-5j8b`; the top level is `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-58` on branch `w2/W2-58`. All five behaviours are built in `src/gov/guard/reads.py` alone:
- **(1) File names given at run time.** A reading command fed names by a pipe into `xargs`, by a `while read` loop, by a `$(…)` or backtick substitution, or by a `for` loop list has its listing judged as a search from where it starts. The guard places `find`, `git ls-files`, `git grep`, `rg --files`/`-l`, `grep -r`/`-l`, `ls`, `echo` and `printf`; filters such as `grep`, `head` and `sed` pass names on. A listing it cannot place refuses a session that has a protected part whose files exist, and no other session.
- **(2) Subagents.** A subagent is refused its session role's parts plus its own type's parts.
- **(3) WBS id.** A ticket given by its WBS id is resolved from `.tickets/*.md` the same way `_load_ticket` does it; the ticket's id, file name and WBS id are all matched against `measures.tickets`.
- **(4) Secrets.** `*.env` at any depth and anything under a `.secrets` folder are refused to every role.
- **(5) No write widening.** `dd of=`, `truncate`, `sort -o`, `rsync`, `patch`, `git checkout` and `git restore` naming either protected file are judged by the write rules' own path check (`_get_allowed_paths` and `_path_allowed`). The refusal message names the rule and DEC-821 and carries no path or file content.

`decide.py`, `protected.py`, `heldout.py`, `containment.py` and the launcher are unchanged. Every new path runs inside `policy_refusal`'s try: during the work, one exception was refused (fail closed), not allowed. The change record has a new §7 (the behaviours, the rules, the evidence, the residuals).
